result.topic_en: Solution counting the 'proper' cases (residues of order exactly n) for the formula x^n - 1 by excluding cases belonging to formulas x^ν - 1 with ν a divisor of n, illustrated by a table for n = 1 to 9.
result.transcription:
PER NVMEROS PRIMOS. 97
Solutio.
A numero omnium caſuum, qui eſt $= n$ excludantur caſus, quibus formulae inferiores in propoſita contentae ſimul fiunt diuiſibiles; aliae autem formulae inferiores veluti $x^{\nu}-1$ in propoſita $x^{n}-1$ non continentur, niſi quarum exponens $\nu$ eſt pars aliquota exponentis $n$. Verum ſi plures huiusmodi formulae inferiores dentur, ne iidem caſus bis vel pluries excludantur, tantum caſus cuique proprii excludi debent, quo facto remanebunt caſus formulae propoſitae $x^{n}-1$ proprii; hoc modo ab exponentibus minoribus ad continuo maiores facile progredi licet:
formula | numerus caſuum propriorum
$x^{1}-1$ | $1$
$x^{2}-1$ | $2-1=1$
$x^{3}-1$ | $3-1=2$
$x^{4}-1$ | $4-1-1=2$
$x^{5}-1$ | $5-1=4$
$x^{6}-1$ | $6-2-1-1=2$
$x^{7}-1$ | $7-1=6$
$x^{8}-1$ | $8-2-1-1=4$
$x^{9}-1$ | $9-2-1=6$
etc.
Hinc in genere ſi $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$, $\delta$ etc. ſint numeri primi, res ita ſe habebit:
Tom. XVIII. Nou. Comm. N for-

items.quote: aliae autem formulae inferiores veluti $x^{\nu}-1$ in propoſita $x^{n}-1$ non continentur, niſi quarum exponens $\nu$ eſt pars aliquota exponentis $n$.
items.english: But other lower formulas such as x^ν - 1 are not contained in the proposed x^n - 1 unless their exponent ν is an aliquot part of the exponent n.

items.quote: tantum caſus cuique proprii excludi debent, quo facto remanebunt caſus formulae propoſitae $x^{n}-1$ proprii
items.english: Only the cases proper to each must be excluded, which done, the cases proper to the proposed formula x^n - 1 will remain.
